meta_title: D.F Painters & Decorators | Professional Painters Bristol
meta_description: D.F Painters and Decorators in Bristol offers interior and exterior painting, decorating, and specialist finishes. Local, reliable, fully insured. Get a free quote today.
hero_subhead: Professional interior and exterior painting for homes and businesses across Bristol. Free quote, no obligation.
services_heading: Complete Painting and Decorating Services in Bristol
services_subhead: From interior redecorating to exterior transformations, we handle residential and commercial projects with precision and care.

services.title: Interior Decorating
services.desc: Complete room repainting, feature walls, and bespoke colour schemes. We protect your furniture and floors, and clear up thoroughly when we're done.

services.title: Exterior Painting
services.desc: Weather-resistant finishes for fascias, soffits, doors, and woodwork. We use trade-grade paints and prepare surfaces properly for lasting results.

services.title: Wallpapering
services.desc: Expert hanging of standard and specialist wallcoverings, including textured and vinyl options. Pattern matching and seam work guaranteed.

services.title: Woodwork Finishing
services.desc: Skirting boards, doors, stairs, and fitted furniture painted to a professional finish. We sand, prime, and apply multiple coats for a durable result.

services.title: Stain and Varnish
services.desc: Wood staining and varnishing services that enhance natural grain while protecting against wear. Perfect for doors, shutters, and garden furniture.

services.title: Commercial Redecorating
services.desc: Shop fronts, offices, and rental properties refreshed quickly with minimal disruption. We work flexibly around your business hours.

about_pullquote: We show up on time, do proper prep work, and leave your home spotless.
about_para_1: D.F Painters and Decorators has been transforming homes and businesses across Bristol since 2010. Founded by David Foster, a qualified painter with a reputation for meticulous attention to detail, the business has grown through word-of-mouth and repeat customers who appreciate our no-fuss approach. We're fully insured and take pride in turning up when we say we will.
about_para_2: Our customers return to us because we don't cut corners on preparation or materials. We cover furniture properly, use premium paints, and clean up at the end of every day. Whether it's a single bedroom or a complete commercial refurbishment, we treat every project with the same care and professionalism.
reviews_heading: What Bristol Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: David and his team painted our entire hallway, stairs and landing. They were tidy, professional, and finished on time. They even moved heavy furniture without being asked. Would definitely recommend.
reviews.author: Michael T.

reviews.text: Had our lounge redecorated after years of scuffs and marks. The colour advice was spot on, and the paint quality is clearly premium — no drips, no mess, brilliant finish. Very happy.
reviews.author: Claire W.

reviews.text: Got a quote within 48 hours, price was fair, and they completed the job exactly as discussed. Refreshed our kitchen in two days. Proper tradesmen, not cowboys. Cheers.
reviews.author: James P.
